# AI Contract & Legal Document Analyzer (MVP)

> **Malt Reference:** *"Analyseur IA de Contrats et Documents Juridiques / Detection de Clauses a Risque"*
> **Average TJM:** 600€ - 850€/jour
> **Estimated Budget Range:** 5,500€ - 9,000€
> **Target Audience:** Legal teams, procurement, and freelancers analyzing NDAs, SaaS contracts, and freelancer agreements for high-risk clauses.

---

## ⚡ Performance Features Built by Bolt
- **Parallel Chunk Processing:** Parses legal text asynchronously in chunked arrays to keep UI interactive on 10,000+ word contracts.
- **Pre-compiled Regex Pattern Matcher:** Clause detection algorithms compile risk regexes upfront into static memory tables.
- **Fast Memoized Risk Score:** Calculates overall risk index using bitmask score aggregation.

---

## 🚀 How to Run Locally
Open `index.html` directly in any browser or launch via root build script (`pnpm run build`).
